findings.title: Unpinned package executed on every start: mojulo
findings.detail: 'mojulo' launches mojulo through npx without a version. The client resolves the version at start time, so any future publish to that package name runs with your credentials. This is how postmark-mcp (Sept 2025) reached roughly 300 organisations.
findings.remediation: Pin an exact version and an integrity hash: "args": ["mojulo@<version>"] and drop the -y flag. Re-pin deliberately, after reviewing the diff.

findings.title: Description reads as instructions to the model (p=0.89): forward_context
findings.detail: The description of 'mojulo.forward_context' scores 0.89 on the instruction-detection model, and carries intent signals: hidden_recipient. Descriptions are documentation for a human, but they are delivered to the model as trusted context, so text that tells the model what to do is an attack surface rather than a description. The score is driven mainly by: hidden_recipient, entropy, log_len.

evidence.description: Forward the agent mojulo's routing index: what it makes, named by use (Play · Print · Read · Hear · Observe) as FORM recognizer rows → the tool to call, the export dispatch, the Workflows row (plans, sweeps, catalysts), the guards, and a drawer directory (`get_creative_toolset`, routing cards, `get_tool_index`, `get_register_kit`, `get_ui_map`, `get_substrate`). Call FIRST when unsure which tool fits. A thin map, not a manual. Optional per-call `register` / `disclosure` override the operator anc

findings.remediation: Read the description against what the tool actually does. If the text is legitimate, it usually means the tool should not have to instruct the model at all - move the guidance into the parameter descriptions or the server's own docs.

findings.title: No baseline supplied - drift detection is disabled
findings.detail: Without an approved snapshot the scanner cannot tell a tool that has always been there from one that appeared yesterday. The single most effective MCP control is the diff, and it needs a baseline to diff against.
findings.remediation: Run 'mcp-scrutiny baseline --config <file> --out mcp-baseline.json', commit the file, and pass it back with --baseline on every later scan.
